note: Confirmed from a macOS user's logs. The pinned comfyui_controlnet_aux requirements.txt ends with an unmarked onnxruntime-gpu, which has no macOS wheel at any version, so pip resolves nothing and the whole node install fails. Retry is deterministic failure. Local engine only - the Pod bakes this node into a CUDA Linux image. Fix cannot live in the command string because runCustomCommand spawns without a shell.

Shipped a851eb18: per-dep per-platform requirementsDrop, filtered before either install path reads requirements.txt, plus the _createDepJob whitelist passthrough without which the fix would be dead on the universal-workflow path. Unit-tested and negative-controlled. NOT verified on a real Mac - earliest proof is a 1.3.0 build in a user's hands.
Needs a real macOS install of a depth model. Code-verified and negative-controlled, but no Apple hardware was available.
